description: Manage Novel archival and checkpoint surfaces. Use when: exporting or importing a Novel (export, import), archiving or unarchiving it (archive, unarchive), cloning or branching it (clone, branch), or setting, listing, restoring, or removing a checkpoint (checkpoint_set, checkpoint_list, checkpoint_restore, checkpoint_remove). Do NOT use when: creating, resuming, renaming, or ending a Novel — use manage_novel. Export and import write files or Novel state; archive, unarchive, clone, branch, and checkpoint mutations persist; revert with manage_history (action: undo); checkpoint_list is read-only.

action.description: export, import, archive, unarchive, clone, branch, checkpoint_set, checkpoint_list, checkpoint_restore, checkpoint_remove.

from_event.description: Event-log ordinal to branch from (branch; default latest).

include_checkpoints.description: Include checkpoints in export (default false; export).

new_name.description: Name for the copy or branch (clone/branch).

source_slug.description: Novel to copy or branch from (clone/branch).

trim_audit_sessions.description: Keep only the most recent N sessions' audit entries in the clone (clone; default full copy).

name: manage_archive

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Novel Archive Management
